If dental courage were a mountain, I used to be stuck at the base — panicking, catastrophising, and crafting last‑minute cancellation texts in my head. Enter Hamish and his spectacular team — precision‑driven, Type‑A perfectionists
with hearts as kind as their clinical skills are sharp.
Special mention to Emily, whose gentle presence could calm even the most "fight‑or‑flight" patient (hi, that’s me).
She and Hamish have a trained eye for spotting every tiny non‑verbal cue — the stiff shoulders, the white‑knuckled hands,
the “I’m smiling but also internally screaming” face.
They notice it all before you even realise you’re doing it.
And then they respond with care so genuine you end up relaxing without even meaning to. Hamish doesn’t just treat teeth —
he takes the time to explain every step, every product, every tool, every reason why. Ask him about prosthodontic ceramics
and he will gladly launch into a full PhD‑level lecture. (Sorry Hamish — I know it was your doctor thesis, but I remember exactly none of the science. Still appreciate the passion though!)
For the first time in my entire dental history, I didn’t cancel a single appointment out of sheer panic. That alone deserves a national award.
And as much as I can confidently say this has been the best dental experience of my life. I also sincerely hope I don’t need to see them too soon again. Nothing personal — I just prefer my teeth behaving themselves.
If you’re looking for professionalism, kindness, precision, and a team who treat you like a human being instead of a dental chart — Nelson Prosthodontists is the place.
Five beautifully polished stars.

My daughter phoned this practice and I was seen later that same day on our way from Akaroa to Dunedin. The reception staff were very welcoming and friendly, the waiting area clean and bright, and I was quickly seen by dentist Alex Hearn.
